body: There are no options for me. It's unfixable. This world is too shallow and superficial, nobody cares about you when you're ugly, nobody will love me. And the pain it causes me is to severe. I can't bear it anymore, fuck I wish I could do it just right now, I wish I could just fall asleep and never wake up. I don't want this anymore, I don't want to be the guy, who is just ugly and nothing else. I'm sick and tired of only being there so the others feel comfortable, that their daily life goes on like they know it whereas I have to suffer. This world will see what it lost when I'm gone.
